sentences.text: 3. It is the contention of the learned learned counsel for the applicant that there was love affair between the applicant and the victim however, just because the applicant and the victim belongs to different community, their marriage proposal could not be materialized due to pressure of community people of the victim and the aforesaid offence came to be registered against the applicant.

It is further contended that the DNA report is not been relied by the Trial Court and the victim was a child within the meaning of the POCSO Act is also doubtful in view of inserting the name of the victim in birth register later on.
According to him, the appeal will take considerable time till then incarceration of the applicant in jail is not justified.
In case the appeal is allowed, the applicant will suffer to a great extent particular when he is 26/27 year old.
4. The learned APP for the State objected the application on the ground that there is ample evidence on record to show that the applicant has committed penetrative sexual assault on the victim.
There is findings of the Trial Court in this regard.

According to him, considering the evidence on record,
the conviction of the applicant is justifiable.
There is no merit in the appeal hence, sought rejection of the application.
RR Jaiswal 3 39-apeal-255-23.odt 5.
Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and after scanning the evidence of prosecution's witnesses, it appears that the victim was pregnant at the time of alleged incident.
During the investigation, the sample of fetus as well as the applicant was taken and the DNA report was filed.
The Trial Court did not accept the DNA report on the point of improper sampling and chain of custody.
Further, the judgment reflects that the name of the victim in birth register has been inserted after 17 years i.e. in the year 2018.
Considering these aspects, a case is made out to scrutinized the evidence of the prosecution's witnesses at the time of hearing of the appeal.
Disposal of the appeal will take considerable time and the applicant is not having any antecedent.
In case, the applicant succeed in the appeal, the position will be irreversible.
Hence, a case is made out of for suspension of substantive sentence imposed upon the applicant till pendency of the appeal.

Hence,
the following order:-
 i) The application is allowed.
 ii) During the pendency of the appeal, the substantive sentence passed in Spl. POCSO Case No. 118/2018 by Extra Jt. Sessions Judge, Akola on 20.03.2023 shall remain suspended.
iii) The applicant be released on bail on executing a PR bond of 10,000/-.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five Thousand) with one solvent surety in the like amount.
